newsitem.title: UK: British husband reincarnated as egg timer.
newsitem.headline: British husband reincarnated as egg timer.

text.p: A British man has been reincarnated as an egg timer in a bid to make his widow smile every time she boils an egg.
Malcolm Eccles, 50, died in February of bowel cancer and his ashes are now stored in a glass egg timer in his family's kitchedn

"I can't boil a soft egg to save my life. He knew that and said I should turn some of his ashes into an egg-timer then he could help me and it would be a nice way of remembering him" his wife Brenda told reporters on Monday.
"Malcom was as daft as a brush. He had a good sense of humour which he kept right through to the end," she added.
The egg timer was made by a specialist glassblowers in south London.
